concerns.text: Task T013f (Generate Real Family-Based Split) is marked as incomplete (unchecked). The spec (SC-002) and Constitution (Principle VI) mandate that the model's accuracy claim is valid ONLY when evaluated against held-out DFT values from material families explicitly excluded from the training set. Without the completed T013f producing `split_indices.json`, the downstream tasks (T018b, T021a) cannot enforce the inter-family generalization constraint, effectively weakening the SC-002 requirement to a standard random split or leaving it unenforceable.

Task T018b (Implement training loop) is marked as incomplete (unchecked). The spec (SC-002, SC-003) and Constitution (Principle VI) require the model to achieve MAPE < 15% on unseen families and inference < 100ms. T018b is the sole producer of the `model_v1.pt` and `predictions.json` artifacts required to verify these criteria. Leaving this task incomplete means the success criteria are not being implemented, constituting a silent relaxation of the FR/SC requirements.

Task T018c (Implement memory enforcement) is marked as incomplete (unchecked). The spec (SC-004) and Constitution (Principle III/VI) require strict adherence to memory limits (7GB) and DFT ground-truth fidelity. T018c implements the specific algorithm (dynamic batch size reduction) to enforce SC-004. Its incomplete status means the memory constraint is not being enforced in the execution path, violating the constitutional requirement for strict adherence to system limits.

Tasks T023 (SHAP) and T024 (Permutation Importance) are marked as incomplete (unchecked). The Constitution (Principle VII) mandates that every claim regarding structural descriptor importance MUST be substantiated by these specific methods. Without these tasks being completed, the project cannot satisfy the constitutional requirement for 'Structural Descriptor Attribution', effectively weakening the research claim to an unsubstantiated correlation.

Task T021b (Inter-Family Validation Gate) is marked as incomplete (unchecked). This task explicitly verifies the disjoint family constraint (SC-002) and enforces the MAPE < 15% threshold with a hard exit. Its incomplete status means the critical gate preventing the project from claiming success without meeting the inter-family generalization requirement is missing, violating the spec's success criteria.

Task T027d (Success Criteria Aggregator) is marked as incomplete (unchecked). This task acts as the final gate for SC-005 (Feature Importance) and aggregates SC-002/SC-003 results. Its incomplete status means there is no final enforcement mechanism to ensure all success criteria are met before the project is considered complete, violating the requirement for a validated deliverable.
